JJKMod.BindingVowDef.label: overtime
JJKMod.BindingVowDef.description: Restrict your cursed technique output to 80% between 08:00 and 18:00 local time. Outside those hours, release the restriction for 120% output. A permanent binding vow inspired by Nanami. Uses the local clock, regardless of the pawn's work schedule. Occupies your single binding-vow slot.

HediffDef.label: binding vow: overtime
HediffDef.description: From 08:00 to 18:00 local time, technique output is multiplied by 0.80. At all other hours it is multiplied by 1.20. The work schedule does not change the vow's hours.
